YOUR LITTLE GROVE

Take your time.

Hold the forge (or Space) for 1 second to unleash 40 strikes over 5 seconds. Recharge takes 10 seconds. Short taps still earn normally. Vibration is used when supported. Your progress saves automatically on this browser. Companions gather embers for up to 8 hours while you’re away.
